info.title: FileX API
info.description: Implemented local-development API for phases 1–6. Generated by scripts/build_contracts.py. Cookie mutations require Origin and X-CSRF-Token; recipient mutations require Origin. Capability, PIN and secrets must never be logged. Production deployment remains gated by phase 7.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Requires exact publicOrigin. Sets HttpOnly SameSite=Strict filexSession cookie. Generic errors and durable per-IP/per-email throttling prevent enumeration. post.summary: Apply or roll back to a validated revision
post.description: Compare-and-set active revision, with an audit record in the same transaction. Select a previous validated revision to roll back. A changed networkPolicy or publicOrigin atomically closes the recovery gate, changes runtime generation, cancels existing requests and requires API/worker restart plus reconciliation/explicit reopening. Trusted proxy addresses are exact IPv4 /32 peers; requireHttps requires requireProxy and an HTTPS origin. ADMIN cookie session with reauthentication within five minutes is required.
